If caller has PROPOSER_ROLE and the operation id is not already scheduled, then schedule(...) does not revert and sets timestamp > 1 (pending).
If this test contract has the PROPOSER_ROLE and schedules a fresh operation with delay >= getMinDelay(), schedule(...) succeeds (does not revert) and sets that operation's timestamp to > 1.

If a proposer schedules an operation with delay >= getMinDelay, then immediately afterwards getTimestamp(id) > 0 and isOperationPending(id) is true iff timestamp > _DONE_TIMESTAMP (i.e., scheduled timestamp > 1) — the test asserts scheduling sets a future timestamp and marking pending.
